Title: Prohibits certain employees with the state from using nonpublic information to gain advantage on prediction markets
Summary: Prohibits certain employees with the state from using nonpublic information to gain advantage on prediction markets; establishes penalties for using nonpublic information on prediction markets.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public officers law, in relation to prohibiting certain employees of the state from using nonpublic information in prediction markets
